question.prompt: The points \((6,12)\) and \((0,-6)\) are connected by a straight line. Another point on this line is:

solutions.explanation:
The midpoint of the segment joining the given points must lie on their line. Moving halfway along a segment halves both coordinate changes, so the midpoint coordinates are the averages of the endpoint coordinates:
\[
\left(\frac{6+0}{2},\frac{12+(-6)}{2}\right)=(3,3).
\]
Thus another point on the line is \((3,3)\), choice \(\boxed{\text{A}}\).
solutions.title: Use the midpoint
